title: RiskShard Loss Event Records Schema
description: Publicly documented cyber loss events with quantified financial impact (ADR-0012, superseding ADR-0005). A record describes ONE organisation's ONE incident, not a cell. Every amount is typed, because the corpus mixes gross losses with insurance proceeds, court settlements and period-over-period deltas, and averaging across those types produces nonsense. These records are tail and defensibility evidence only: they may not be aggregated into a central tendency, and they carry no exceedance probability.

id.description: Stable, citable identifier (ADR-0004). Never reused, never renamed.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, when the source is an EDGAR filing.

company_size_band.description: Declared only when the filing supports it. Absent is honest; guessing is not.

description.description: Factual and neutral. No characterisation, no blame, no inference beyond the filing.

date.description: ISO date or year-month, at the precision the source states.

date_precision.description: Declared, never inferred. The Destroyed by Breach measurement found 18 of 37 dates were a month or year coerced into an exact day; once coerced the distinction is unrecoverable.

amounts.description: One or more typed amounts. A record with no amount does not belong in this registry.

type.description: The type is the point. 'insurance_recovery' is money received, not lost; 'period_delta' is a change between periods, not an event total. Mixing them is the failure this field exists to prevent.

basis.description: Whether recoveries are already deducted. Filings state both often enough that the confound is visible rather than hidden — but only if it is recorded.

period.description: The period the amount covers, as the filing states it.

status.description: Disclosures routinely report costs incurred to date; final amounts land quarters later.

units_resolved_from.description: Where the magnitude was confirmed when the sentence alone was ambiguous — e.g. a statement header reading 'in thousands'. Required by the census hazard: a face-value read of a table figure is wrong by 1000x.

cited_line.description: The exact sentence from the filing. Quoted, not paraphrased, so a reader can confirm it.

method.description: ADR-0012 requires verification-assisted extraction and forbids automatic. 12 of 50 machine candidates in the census were wrong, in six distinct ways, so an unconfirmed candidate is not a record. This enum has one value on purpose.

candidate_source.description: The discovery lane that surfaced it, for reproducibility.

limitations.description: What this record cannot support. Never empty: at minimum it carries the corpus-level biases — selection toward listed entities, materiality censoring, and provisional figures.
